source.title: Aqueduct 4.0: Updated decision-relevant global water risk indicators (WRI, 2023)
source.locator: PDF/printed page 11, Baseline water stress; page 12, Limitations

interpretation_limit: Baseline water stress compares total demand with renewable supply. Annual values weight monthly stress by demand. Five risk bands and a separate arid status are reported. The range table does not settle every exact endpoint. Formula printing conflicts with the prose clipping description; use verified provider outputs, not that printed expression.
registration_blocker: Four-class interpretation, none condition, special-status handling and actual output metadata remain unresolved.
